how_to_apply: Follow these steps to complete the SGGU Assistant Professor Apply Online process:
Visit the official SGGU recruitment portal at https://www.sggu.ac.in/recruitement.php and fill the online application form for the desired post.
Pay the applicable application fee (Rs. 2,000/- for General category or Rs. 1,500/- for other categories) through the online mode.
After submitting the online application, take a printout (hardcopy) of the submitted form.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates proving qualifications, experience, publications, and all other claims, arranged in proper sequence with numbering as per the checklist in Annexure-II.

Send the hardcopy application with all enclosures to: "The Establishment Officer (OSD), Shri Govind Guru University, Vinzol – 388713" by Registered Post/Speed Post or in person, on or before 25 September 2026, up to 5:00 PM.
In-service candidates must also submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their current employer, or an Annexure-III endorsement from the employer.
Applications without online submission, hardcopy sent without the corresponding online application, incomplete applications, or applications on plain paper will not be considered.
important_instructions: SEBC candidates must submit a valid Non-Creamy-Layer certificate for the current financial year in the prescribed format. SC/ST/SEBC/EWS/PwBD candidates must submit the prescribed certificate as per State Government norms; failure to do so will forfeit reserved-category benefits. Candidates with a foreign university degree must produce an equivalence certificate from the Association of Indian Universities (AIU). Providing incorrect or false information, or suppressing information, will lead to disqualification and, if already appointed, dismissal. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate online application, hardcopy, and requisite fee for each post. Direct or indirect canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Any changes, amendments, or updates regarding this recruitment will be posted only on the official university website, which candidates should check regularly. In case of any dispute, the territorial jurisdiction will be Godhra only.

content_sections.heading: SGGU Assistant Professor Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: SGGU has announced 31 Assistant Professor vacancies (Academic Level-10) spread across 17 departments. One post is reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD – Category A: Blind and Low Vision), and several posts are reserved for women candidates as indicated below. Note: "(W)" denotes a post earmarked for women candidates, and "(A)" denotes the PwBD (Blind and Low Vision) post under Biotechnology. Reservation for Persons with Disabilities will follow the existing Government of Gujarat, Department of Social Justice and Empowerment norms.

content_sections.heading: SGGU Assistant Professor Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility for SGGU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 is governed by the UGC Regulations on Minimum Qualifications for Appointment of Teachers, 2018, University Rules, and, for technical disciplines, AICTE Notification, 2019. The core requirement applicable across most disciplines is: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade where a grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. The candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by UGC or CSIR, or an equivalent test such as GSLET/GSET/SLET/SET, OR have been awarded a Ph.D. degree in accordance with the UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016. Candidates registered for a Ph.D. before 11 July 2009 may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET subject to conditions specified in the notification (regular-mode Ph.D., evaluation by at least two external examiners, open viva voce, two research papers with at least one in a refereed journal, and presentation of at least two conference papers). NET/SLET/SET is not required for Master's programmes in disciplines where these tests are not conducted by UGC/CSIR or an accredited body. Alternatively, a Ph.D. obtained from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 in the QS, THE, or Shanghai (ARWU) World University Rankings is also accepted. Certain disciplines have separate or additional eligibility routes, detailed in the qualification section below. The prescribed qualifications, experience, and non-creamy-layer certificate (where applicable) will be considered as of the last date for submitting the online application.

content_sections.heading: SGGU Assistant Professor Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: The general Master's degree plus NET/SET/Ph.D. route applies to the Disciplines of Arts, Humanities, Social Sciences, Sciences, Languages, Social Work, and Law. Additional or alternate qualification routes are specified for the following disciplines: Candidates should refer to the full official notification and UGC Regulations, 2018, for the complete discipline-wise eligibility text before applying, as conditions vary by department.

rows.additional_alternate_qualification_route: B.Pharm. + registration as pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948 + First Class Master's degree in the relevant specialization + Ph.D. in Pharmacy; OR a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked in the top 500 (QS/THE/ARWU).

Master's degree (55%) + NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. as above; OR a traditional/professional artist with a Bachelor's degree who has studied under a noted Master/Artist, holds an "A" grade from AIR/Doordarshan, and can teach theory with illustrations.

Master's degree in Physical Education/Sports (55%) + representation at inter-university/inter-collegiate or state/national championships + NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D.; OR an Asian Games/Commonwealth Games medal winner with at least a postgraduate degree.

Eligibility as per AICTE Regulations, 2019 (B.E./B.Tech. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S., or Integrated M.Tech., or MCA with First Class plus relevant conditions) OR eligibility as per UGC Regulations, 2018 (Master's degree with 55% in Computer Applications/Computer Science/IT + NET/SLET/SET, or a qualifying Ph.D.).

Bachelor's degree in any discipline + Master's degree in Business Administration/CA/IPGDM/ICWA/M.Com with First Class + two years of professional experience after the Master's degree, along with NET/GSLET/GSET or a qualifying Ph.D. Professional experience is exempted for Ph.D. holders/Fellows in Management from AICTE-approved institutions or IIMs.
Bachelor's and Master's degree in the relevant branch with First Class or equivalent in at least one of the two degrees, plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant professional experience.

faq.question: Q1. What is SGGU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is the recruitment drive by Shri Govind Guru University, Vinzol-Godhra (Advertisement No. 06/2026) to fill 31 Assistant Professor posts across 17 departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SGGU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 31 vacancies are available, distributed across 17 departments including Economics, Psychology, Hindi, Computer Science, Mathematics, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Performing Arts, Physical Education, Sanskrit, Library Science, MBA, Law, Botany, Master of Social Work, and Fine Arts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SGGU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application can be submitted until 17 September 2026, and the hardcopy of the application must reach the university by 25 September 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for SGGU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Generally, a Master's degree with 55% marks in the relevant subject along with NET/SET/SLET, or a qualifying Ph.D., as per UGC Regulations, 2018. Some disciplines such as Pharmacy, Computer Science, Performing Arts, Physical Education, Management, and Fine Arts have additional or alternate qualification routes.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SGGU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SGGU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 2,000/- for General category candidates and Rs. 1,500/- for other category candidates, payable online and non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for SGGU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply through the official portal at https://www.sggu.ac.in/recruitement.php, then send the printed hardcopy with self-attested documents to the Establishment Officer (OSD), SGGU, Vinzol, before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SGGU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on an Academic Score (maximum 100 marks) as per Table 3A, and final selection is based only on performance in the personal interview.
